Description
Falmouth University, located in Cornwall, England, is a leading specialist institution for the creative industries, evolving from the Falmouth School of Arts (est. 1902) to university status in 2012. It offers industry-facing, hands-on courses across two campuses (Falmouth and Penryn) for over 7,900 students, focusing on employability in design, digital media, and performance.
